gaps.label: Workspace git foundation
gaps.impact: Branch-aware checks are now available because the workspace is a git repository on UIXAppTTR.
gaps.nextAction: Keep branch policy visible and preserve non-destructive publish flow.
gaps.closureMetric: Publish readiness reports the expected UIXAppTTR branch.
gaps.rollback: Keep source edits local and avoid remote operations.

gaps.label: GitHub publication authentication
gaps.impact: Remote publication remains unsafe while authentication and remote mapping are unresolved.
gaps.nextAction: Run bounded publish preflight and push only intended changes.
gaps.closureMetric: Publish readiness reports clean branch, remote visibility, and GitHub CLI authentication without auth blockers.
gaps.rollback: Keep iCloud/local copy as source of truth until auth is valid.

gaps.label: Visual runtime evidence
gaps.impact: Cinematic layering exists but needs repeatable review criteria.
gaps.nextAction: Keep motion evidence checks active before adding heavier cinematic layers.
gaps.closureMetric: Static motion evidence verifies reduced-motion, balanced, and cinematic hooks.
gaps.rollback: Lock to reduced motion defaults if instability appears.

gaps.label: Mobile ergonomics
gaps.impact: Touch and layout stability still need periodic checks as sections grow.
gaps.nextAction: Keep mobile ergonomics checks active before adding denser sections.
gaps.closureMetric: Static mobile ergonomics verifies breakpoint, wrapping, touch sizing, and overflow guards.
gaps.rollback: Reduce section density before adding new motion.

gaps.label: Accessibility and reduced motion coverage
gaps.impact: The base experience can stay premium while preserving cognitive comfort.
gaps.nextAction: Keep reduced-motion checks active in every workspace quality pass.
gaps.closureMetric: check-workspace validates prefers-reduced-motion support in CSS and JS.

gaps.label: Release artifact freshness
gaps.impact: A stale release package creates drift between source and shipment.
gaps.nextAction: Refresh release folder only after source changes.
gaps.closureMetric: release/web contains current index, style, and script files.
gaps.rollback: Pause release refresh when source checks are failing.

gaps.label: Cloud environment contract
gaps.impact: Server and cloud shipment can be planned without committing secrets or selecting the wrong provider.
gaps.nextAction: Pick one provider, set deploy-time environment values, then rerun cloud and publish readiness checks.
gaps.closureMetric: check-cloud-environment validates providers, secrets policy, polyglot runtime, and rollback guardrails.
gaps.rollback: Remove provider candidate or pause deployment until target ownership is confirmed.

gaps.label: Connector and MCP capability registry
gaps.impact: Skills, plugins, MCP servers, and connectors are visible without being invoked chaotically.
gaps.nextAction: Use only the connector that directly supports the active coding, deploy, observability, or handoff task.
gaps.closureMetric: Connector registry lists activation policy and quality command for every candidate connector.
gaps.rollback: Disable connector usage by leaving candidate status and requiring explicit approval.

rules: Each gap must include priority, closureMetric, and at least one quality command.
Blocked gaps must stop before remote push or deployment.
Ready gaps can be implemented in one reversible slice.
Watch gaps require periodic review and evidence logging.
